prompts.prompt: BIND 9.20 replaced the RBTDB database engine as its default data structure. What is the new default engine called? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/bind/references/versions/9.20.md - QP-Trie Database replaces RBTDB as default, 4-7% authoritative performance improvement

prompts.prompt: The auto-dnssec option in named.conf now causes BIND to refuse to start if present. Which BIND version removed it, and what feature should you use instead? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/bind/references/versions/9.20.md - auto-dnssec causes startup failure in 9.20, use dnssec-policy (KASP) instead

prompts.prompt: In BIND named.conf, once you define even a single view, must every zone -- including localhost and root hints -- be placed inside a view? Answer in one sentence.
